data.title: Therapy Kaise Chune? 5-Point Quick Guide
data.title_en: How to Choose Therapy: 5-Point Quick Guide
data.hook_text: THERAPY IS NOT FOR CRAZY – Aaj jaaniye ek aisa fayda jo aapko hairaan kar dega!

scenes.text: Ruk jao agar lagta hai therapy sirf pagalpan hai.
scenes.text_en: Stop if you think therapy is only for severe madness.
scenes.text_hi: रुक जाओ अगर लगता है therapy सिर्फ पागलपन है।

scenes.text: Therapy dimaag ka gym hai, aur teesra step sabse zaroori.
scenes.text_en: Therapy is a mental gym, and step three matters most.
scenes.text_hi: Therapy दिमाग का gym है, और तीसरा step सबसे ज़रूरी है।

scenes.text: Research kehti hai CBT, jaise Rohit, engineering student, anxiety aur sadness kam karne mein kaafi effective hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests CBT, like Rohit the engineering student, effectively reduces anxiety and low mood.
scenes.text_hi: Research कहती है CBT, जैसे रोहित, engineering student, anxiety और sadness कम करने में काफी effective है।

scenes.text: Ye us dost ko bhejo jo overthinking se thak chuka hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this to that friend who is exhausted from overthinking.
scenes.text_hi: ये उस दोस्त को भेजो जो overthinking से थक चुका है।

scenes.text: Sahi therapy chunne ke liye ye simple five-point checklist follow karo.
scenes.text_en: Follow this simple five-point checklist to pick the right therapy.
scenes.text_hi: सही therapy चुनने के लिए ये simple five-point checklist follow करो।

scenes.text: Pehle apna goal decide karo, phir weekly time commitment dekho.
scenes.text_en: First decide your clear goal, then check your weekly time commitment.
scenes.text_hi: पहले अपना goal decide करो, फिर weekly time commitment देखो।

scenes.text: Teesra point, kya therapist ke saath baat karne mein safe lagta hai?
scenes.text_en: Third point, do you feel completely safe talking with that therapist?
scenes.text_hi: तीसरा point, क्या therapist के साथ बात करने में safe लगता है?

scenes.text: Chautha access aur paanchva budget, jo long term sustain ho sake.
scenes.text_en: Fourth is easy access and fifth is a budget you can sustain long term.
scenes.text_hi: चौथा access और पाँचवाँ budget, जो long term sustain हो सके।

scenes.text: Thoughts badalne ke liye CBT, feelings express karne ke liye talk therapy.
scenes.text_en: Try CBT to reshape thoughts, or talk therapy to express bottled emotions.
scenes.text_hi: Thoughts बदलने के लिए CBT, feelings express करने के लिए talk therapy।

scenes.text: Help maangna kamzori nahi, self-awareness ki sabse badi nishani hai.
scenes.text_en: Asking for help is not weakness; it is genuine self-awareness.
scenes.text_hi: Help माँगना कमज़ोरी नहीं, self-awareness की सबसे बड़ी निशानी है।

scenes.text: Toh khud par bharosa rakho aur therapy lene se bilkul mat darna.
scenes.text_en: Trust yourself gently, and never fear reaching out for therapy guidance.
scenes.text_hi: तो खुद पर भरोसा रखो और therapy लेने से बिल्कुल मत डरना।

scenes.text: Aaj hi ek therapist book karo aur apni mental fitness shuru karo!
scenes.text_en: Book a therapist today and start your mental fitness journey!
scenes.text_hi: Aaj hi ek therapist book karo aur apni mental fitness shuru karo!

data.description: Understanding therapy types doesn't have to be confusing. Here is a simple 5-point checklist to find the right support for your mental wellness.
